Piškótová Roláda / Roulade / Biscuit Roulé / Swiss Roll

Time: time
Servings: servings
Source: Stará mama Dunajská Streda
Tags: tested, sweet, dessert, medium-effort, vegetarian, milk-free

Ingredients

  • 6 eggs
  • 120g sugar
  • 60g flour

Instructions

Preheat the oven to 175°C
Separate the eggs. Foam the yolks with sugar, until they’re pale, fluffy, and the sugar has dissolved.
Mix in the flour. Beat egg whites into stiff peaks and fold them into the batter.
Pour onto a tray lined with baking paper, bake for about 10min, until it start smelling and gets golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Take the tray out and flip the cake upside-down. Peel off the baking paper and roll it. Let it cool rolled up.
After it’s cool, fill with your preferred filling: Whipped cream (needs to be stiff, so use double cream or a stiffener), berries, mascarpone frosting, jam, curd, chocolate ganache, chocolate spread, buttercream, pastry cream… Anything goes. If you pick a wet filling (such as whipped cream), it’s best to “seal off” the cake with jam first.

Designed by me in 2019. I stole the pictures from the Internet.
